name: Prompt Agents — static gateway
summary: Foundry Prompt Agent (PromptAgentDefinition) created with model routed through the static APIM AI Gateway connection.
description: `project.agents.create_version(..., PromptAgentDefinition(model='{static-connection}/{deployment}', ...))` creates a v2 Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is routed through a static APIM AI Gateway connection. Invoking it through the Responses API proves users can run standard Prompt Agents without a local Foundry model deployment.
notes:
Verified end-to-end via `PromptAgentDefinition(model='{static-connection}/{deployment}')` and `aoai.responses.create(..., extra_body={'agent_reference': ...})`. See `test.py`.

Requires `AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_STATIC` to point at an `ApiManagement` connection on the Foundry project.
